sourceReferenceRule: Every sole-key $ref object resolves to the zero-based pool list entry.

modifiers.source: current LWJGL physical keyboard state, read only

coverage.vanilla: Forge-captured buttons and ordinary container slots; per-slot tooltip queried on demand
coverage.mui2: bounded public open panels/widget tree, identities, bounds, enabled state
coverage.text: Vanilla button displayString, MUI2 TextWidget public IKey.getFormatted; other drawn labels may be unavailable
coverage.richTooltips: MUI2 public RichTooltip.isEmpty refreshes native dirty builders, then getRichText/getAsStrings; rich icons/clipping/topmost hit state not reconstructed
coverage.textures: MUI2 public Widget.getOverlay/getBackground, DynamicDrawable.getSupplier and UITexture resource/UV data; no drawing or physical hover changes
coverage.itemSlots: Public ItemSlot.getSlot/getVanillaSlot and exact native container lookup bind current widget display to a container slot ID; machine/player ownership needs its separate verified binding. Access flags and filter presence are not candidate acceptance.
coverage.aeVirtualSlots: unavailable; ordinary container slots and public AE button messages only, cached physical hover is never changed
coverage.creativeInventory: Actual public tabs and inventory-tab player slots are exposed in controls/gui.widgets with screen-bound widget IDs. activate uses native tab callbacks or one fixed left pickup callback; synchronization requires a later inspection.
coverage.modifierPolicy: Current physical Shift/Ctrl/Alt state only; advanced=true is not Shift expansion. No simulated keys, hover, drawing, or screenshot fallback.

data.source: current ItemStack.getTooltip(player, advanced); original NBT preserved

budget.policy: Soft budget includes public getters and JSON construction; a single getter cannot be preempted. At least one compiled entry progresses per page.

exactFailedTaskResourceDiagnostics.source: Fresh read-only current resource observations after failure; accepted checkpoints are separately labelled. No replay or automatic recovery.

protectedRetainedState.reason: owned finite test material after acknowledged native input fill, before recipe feed; retain for public-capacity recovery

limitation: Actual retained R17 failure after one acknowledged native input activation and shell return, before ordinary recipe feed. Offline fixtures cannot establish live recovery or live output tuple capacity.
